chunks: Aḥmad, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Mālik al-Juhanī, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:
“And this Qur'an has been revealed to me that I may warn you by it, and whomever it reaches.”
He عليه السلام said: “Whomever it reaches such that he is an Imam from the Progeny of Muḥammad, he warns by the Qur'an just as the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله warned by it.”

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله; the Prophet’s progeny
key_terms.أُوحِيَ: was revealed; indicates divine revelation of the Qur'an
key_terms.إِمَامًا: an Imam; a divinely designated leader from the Prophet’s family
key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the Qur'an as the revealed means of warning and guidance
key_terms.بَلَغَ: it reached; referring to the continuation of the message's reach
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لِأُنْذِرَكُمْ: that I may warn you; conveying divine warning and admonition
key_terms.يُنْذِرُ: he warns; carrying out the function of warning through the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by “and whomever it reaches” in Qur'an 6:19 according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase “and whomever it reaches” as applying to the Imams from the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله. It presents them as continuing the function of warning by means of the Qur'an, just as the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم did, thereby affirming their divinely guided religious authority.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Abdul Azeem, from Ibn Azina, from Malik Al Juhny who said,
[6:19] and this Quran has been Revealed to me that with it I may warn you, and whomsoever it reaches

. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one whom it reaches that he becomes an Imam<sup>asws</sup>, from the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>as</sup>. He<sup>asws</sup> would warn with the Quran just as Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had warned with it’.
en.sarwar: 61. Ahmad has narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim from al-Husayn ibn Mayyah from those who informed him has said the following “A man read this verse before abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) “
(Muhammad), tell them, “Act as you wish. God, His Messenger and the believers will see your deeds. . .” [9:105]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is not all believers. It refers to the infalliable ones among them. We are the infallible ones.”
